audit.why: Favoured 4/10 matches 56.89% WR over 1364 games; early bully, Azir out-scales at 2+ items — the text already says both.
Spikes (level 2 QE, 6 R execute, Luden's, Azir 2+ items) are present and consistent with both kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shifting Sands' shield (absorbs burst) is never stated, and breakdown.cooldowns carries no numbers despite Azir E being 22s at rank 1.
audit.why: Azir E is dash + shield per Riot's text; brief flags shield-absorbs-burst as a missing interaction.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries 22s/16s for his E and 15s for your E, and names the shield.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Scatter the Weak for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands: 22s at rank 1, 16s max — his only dash and a shield that eats your burst; once he burns it he is immobile for the full timer, so that is the QE window. - Your E is 15s flat: budget it for his commit, never for poke.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Two grounded spheres turn E into a wide instant stun and make R lethal on demand — restock between trades, not during them.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: With R down (120s at rank 1) your pick threat is gone, and his soldiers poke from 1100 range off Shifting Sands — shove, reset, and re-enter with the ult up.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Azir wins by farming safely off soldiers, shielding through your burst with Shifting Sands, and scaling to two items.

edits.before: Carry through picks — QE-into-R removes one carry per fight before it starts; your job is the sphere bank that makes it arithmetic.
edits.after: Carry through picks — QE-into-R deletes Azir before Emperor's Divide can peel, and a dead Azir is a team with no mid-late DPS engine.

edits.before: You are the carry-deleter: flank the fight, QE the priority target, and R them out of the game before their team notices. Sphere discipline is damage discipline.
edits.after: Azir out-scales you at three items — soldiers shred from range and Emperor's Divide walls off your flank. Pick him with QE-R before the front line forms and the fight never starts.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: With R down (120s at rank 1) your pick threat is gone and his soldiers outrange you — shove, reset, and re-enter with the ult up.
